entries.zh: 意思相合，意见一致；（对某事）看法相同
entries.en: to agree in opinion; to be of the same mind (about something)
entries.notes: 词头中段为红线划掩，末段 recer 与 H「合意思」合推为 17 世纪 Conuenir en parecer（意见相合）。

entries.zh: 合同，契约；全面议定一致（vt supra：同上条）
entries.en: contract, agreement; to agree on everything (as above)
Buddhist monastery (of the bonzes); specifically the Kaiyuan Temple
entries.notes: H「開元寺」与 M/R 开元寺对音一致；L「Bon cas」所指寺名待考，疑为 bonzo（和尚）之转写。
R 栏「xīn」与「院」对音不合，存疑；H 寺院与 M sȳ yā̃ 一致。

entries.en: to associate with; to have dealings (with someone)
entries.notes: M「sio caú」即相交；R「guiān」对音未安，故降置信。

entries.zh: 消化（食物）；（质体）转化、变化
entries.en: to digest; to convert, to change (into another substance)
entries.notes: L 首词残缺，据 mudar, digerir 定为 conuerter/convertir；H「消化」与 M/R 互证。
L「Conuers de nauis」拼写异常，疑为 conués（甲板）之误录；H 船面与 M chūn bī̃、R chuēn miēn 一致。

entries.en: it behoves; one must, it is necessary
entries.notes: M 栏「tuī tit, zūi: cay tōng: cap.」与 H「須」音义皆不合，且 L 附注 liquito 未详，难以定夺。

entries.en: it is fitting, it is permissible; one may
entries.notes: H「可」与 R coʰ 一致，但 M 栏作 tang（当），与「可」不谐；L 末 liquito 语义未详。

entries.en: ought to; it is obligatory, there is an obligation
must, to have to; it is proper that
one must by all means (do it so)
certainly, necessarily; it must be so
entries.notes: R 栏起首残缺（[残] pit tēng），仅存 pit 一音节可辨。

entries.zh: 合该，理应；本当如此（含义务义）
entries.en: ought to; it is one's bounden duty (to)
ought to; to deserve, to be fitting
that is precisely (it); it amounts to
entries.notes: L 末词 afaller 未详（疑为 aplicar/afirmar 之类误录），释义依 H「就是」及 M/R chiū sȳ 音写。
